headline: Nigeria Central Bank Imposes $11 Million Licensing Rule for Dollar Stablecoins
summary: Nigeria's central bank published licensing rules requiring dollar stablecoin issuers to hold about $11.1 million in capital and operate through a Nigerian company.
why: Clear regulatory frameworks for stablecoins impact fintech operations, crypto exchanges, and digital asset adoption in Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: New regulatory capital rules directly govern stablecoin issuers operating within Nigeria.
